items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
Thousands form the numerical setting given.
Womb-diagrams are named as the locations involved.
Torment is attributed to those present in those locations.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of those tormented remains unspecified.
The cause of torment is not stated by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places where beings are tormented.
